name: Bodegas Riojanas, S.A.
summary: Bodegas Riojanas, S.A. engages in winemaking business in Spain and internationally. The company offers its wine products under the Monte Real, Viña Albina, Puerta Vieja, Gran Albina, Viore, Borisa, Peñamonte, Pascali, Marqués de Peñamonte, Veiga Naúm, Pierrel, Alacer, and Canchales names. It also sells its products online. The company was founded in 1890 and is based in Cenicero, Spain.
